create_DCPModelWrapper: create a DCPModelWrapper instance wrapping a single torch.nn.Module for distributed checkpointing
create_DCPModelWrapper_list: create a DCPModelWrapper instance wrapping a list of torch.nn.Module models for distributed checkpointing
get_state_dict: call state_dict on a DCPModelWrapper to extract the model state dictionary for saving
load_state_dict: call load_state_dict on a DCPModelWrapper to restore model state from a saved dictionary
review_DCPModelWrapper: review the DCPModelWrapper class and its state_dict and load_state_dict methods for distributed checkpoint usage
